title: ESC executive board and committees
description: One academic year of the Engineering Student Council executive board, plus the committees they lead. Rendered by the exec/committee tab. Array order is display order.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema so editors like VS Code offer autocomplete, e.g. "../schemas/execs.schema.json".

term.description: Academic year this board serves, written as two consecutive years like "2025-2026".

members.description: Executive board members, in the order they should appear on the page (presidents first).

committees.description: Committees for this term. A member's "committee" field must match one of these ids.

id.description: Stable lowercase slug used for anchors and cross-references, e.g. "evan-wong" or "eweek". Letters, digits and single hyphens only.

berkeleyEmail.description: A berkeley.edu address (role mailboxes like president@esc.studentorg.berkeley.edu are preferred over personal ones).

id.description: Unique slug for this person, usually first-last, e.g. "laura-viera".

name.description: Full name as the person wants it displayed.

pronouns.description: Optional pronouns, shown next to the name, e.g. "she/her".

role.description: Position title exactly as it should appear, e.g. "Co-President" or "Technical Director".

email.description: Contact address for this role. Co-holders of a role may share one mailbox (e.g. both Co-Presidents use president@esc.studentorg.berkeley.edu).

committee.description: Id of the committee this member leads, matching an entry in "committees". Leave out for roles without a committee.

graduationYear.description: Expected graduation year as a number, e.g. 2027. Preferred over "3rd year" because it does not go stale each semester.

bio.description: Short plain-text bio (no HTML), up to about three sentences.

headshot.description: Path to the photo relative to the site root, with the exact same capitalization as the file, e.g. "exec2025/Evan.JPG". No leading slash, "./" or http(s). The file must exist in the repo.

id.description: Unique slug for the committee, e.g. "finance" or "eweek".

description.description: Plain-text description of what the committee does (no HTML).

url.description: Optional link to a page with more detail. Either a site-relative page like "ficomm.html" or a full https URL.
